dedupe_keys.name: catalogo oficial de datos y servicios inspire flood hazard datasets

description: Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. Coverage: Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mapa de puntos de especial importancia en riesgo inundación fluvial T=; Mapa de riesgo inundación fluvial económico T=10 años; Mapa de riesgo inundación fluvial económico T=100 años; Zonas inundables con alta probabilidad (T= 10 años). Formats seen: XML, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
